title: CSG Systems International Announces Its 13th Consecutive Year of Increased Dividend Payout
summary: Board of Directors approves a 6% increase in its quarterly dividend; company approves Q1 2026 dividend CSG® (NASDAQ: CSGS) today announced that its Board of Directors approved a 6% increase in the Company’s quarterly cash dividend payment. The new quarterly payment amount has been increased to $0.34 per share of common stock to be paid on April 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 18, 2026.
